We're picking an on-call scheduling tool for our engineering team of 40 people, and we need single sign-on. Please read the pricing pages for Rotamere, Wakespan and Vigilark:

https://rotamere.example/pricing
https://wakespan.example/pricing

Then work out what 40 seats with single sign-on would cost for a year on yearly billing at each vendor, and recommend the cheapest. Stick to what the pages say.

# On-call tool pricing (40 seats, SSO required)

Source: each vendor's public pricing page. All prices in USD, per user/seat per month. Taxes are excluded or may apply.

## Rotamere (https://rotamere.example/pricing)

| Plan | Yearly billing | Monthly billing | Seat minimum | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Free | $0 (up to 5 users) | n/a | none stated | One schedule, community support |
| Team | $19 | $23 | none stated | Unlimited schedules and escalation policies, overrides and swaps |
| Business | $36 | $43 | 10 users | Everything in Team, plus SAML SSO and SCIM, audit log, role-based access |
| Enterprise | Talk to sales | Talk to sales | not stated | Everything in Business, plus dedicated support engineer |

- **SSO:** included in Business (SAML SSO and SCIM). There is no separate SSO charge. It is not in Team.
- Only people who go on call need a paid seat. Stakeholders are free.
- Yearly plans are billed up front for the full year.

## Wakespan (https://wakespan.example/pricing)

| Plan | Annual billing | Monthly billing | Seat minimum | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Starter | $16 | $20 | none stated | Schedules, escalation rules, mobile app |
| Professional | $29 | $35 | none stated | Adds incident analytics, service dependencies, API access |
| Enterprise | $47 (annual only) | not offered | 25 users | Adds SSO (SAML and OIDC), advanced permissions, 99.95% uptime commitment |

- **SSO:** only on Enterprise, at $47/user/mo, annual billing only. There is no separate SSO charge.
- 14-day trial on every plan. Nonprofits get 30% off annual plans (we are not assuming this applies).
- Annual plans auto-renew unless cancelled 30 days before renewal.

## Vigilark (https://vigilark.example/pricing)

| Plan | Annual billing | Monthly billing | Seat minimum | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Basic | $11 | $14 | none | Schedules, rotations, escalations, alerts |
| Pro | $24 | $30 | 8 seats | Adds follow-the-sun rotations, postmortem templates, audit trail, priority support |

- **SSO:** SAML SSO is an add-on on Pro only, at $4/seat/mo, billed the same way as the plan. Pro with SSO is therefore $28/seat/mo annual, or $34/seat/mo monthly.
- Extra phone alerts outside North America and Europe are billed at cost.
- Support agents can see who is on call without a paid seat.
- You can switch between annual and monthly billing at renewal.

## Cost of 40 seats with SSO, one year, yearly billing

| Vendor | Plan needed | Per seat per month | Calculation | Yearly total |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Vigilark | Pro + SSO add-on | $24 + $4 = $28 | 40 × $28 × 12 | **$13,440** |
| Rotamere | Business | $36 | 40 × $36 × 12 | $17,280 |
| Wakespan | Enterprise | $47 | 40 × $47 × 12 | $22,560 |

All three minimums (Rotamere 10, Wakespan 25, Vigilark 8) are met by 40 seats.

## Recommendation

**Vigilark Pro with the SSO add-on is the cheapest at $13,440 a year.** That is $3,840 less than Rotamere Business and $9,120 less than Wakespan Enterprise.

Caveats:
- This assumes all 40 people need paid seats. Rotamere and Vigilark both say people who don't take shifts can be free, so the real number could be lower at either.
- Vigilark's SSO is SAML only. Wakespan also offers OIDC. Rotamere's Business plan also includes SCIM provisioning and role-based access. Check that these match your identity provider and requirements.
- Vigilark may bill extra for phone alerts outside North America and Europe.
- The pages don't say whether the Rotamere or Vigilark yearly price is locked for the term. Confirm with the vendor.

|---|---|---|---|---|
| Vigilark | Pro + SSO add-on | $24 + $4 = $28 | 40 × $28 × 12 | **$13,440** |
| Rotamere | Business | $36 | 40 × $36 × 12 | $17,280 |
| Wakespan | Enterprise | $47 | 40 × $47 × 12 | $22,560 |

All three minimums (Rotamere 10, Wakespan 25, Vigilark 8) are met by 40 seats.

## Recommendation

**Vigilark Pro with the SSO add-on is the cheapest at $13,440 a year.** That is $3,840 less than Rotamere Business and $9,120 less than Wakespan Enterprise.

Caveats:
- This assumes all 40 people need paid seats. Rotamere and Vigilark both say people who don't take shifts can be free, so the real number could be lower at either.
- Vigilark's SSO is SAML only. Wakespan also offers OIDC. Rotamere's Business plan also includes SCIM provisioning and role-based access. Check that these match your identity provider and requirements.
- Vigilark may bill extra for phone alerts outside North America and Europe.
- The pages don't say whether the Rotamere or Vigilark yearly price is locked for the term. Confirm with the vendor.
